name: eco
description: ECO connects ChatGPT and Codex to the lnwjud Windows-first local MCP runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Use ECO to work with your Windows machine
interface.longDescription: ECO routes ChatGPT and Codex workflows to the connected lnwjud MCP runtime. Files, processes, Windows automation, browser control, Office actions, and other side effects continue to run on the user's Windows machine under lnwjud permissions and approval boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Use ECO to list workspaces, show Git status for the active project, and summarize the top-level tree without changes.
Use ECO to inspect this project, make the requested code change, run the narrow relevant tests, and show the Git diff.
Use ECO to observe the Windows target first, then perform only the requested UI action within current permissions.
